news.title: b12181: hexagon: fuse post-norm residual add into RMS_NORM_MUL (#31822)
news.dek:
hexagon: fuse post-norm residual add into RMS_NORM_MUL 
 
 
 hex-fusion: refactor RMS_NORM fusion and add dedicated RMS_NORM_MUL_ADD opcode 
 
 
 Improves performance by keeping things in HVX registers. 
Also simplifies overall fusion logic and logging. 
 
 Co-authored-by: Max Kr
news.aiSummary: This commit refactors the RMS_NORM fusion logic for the Hexagon architecture by introducing a dedicated RMS_NORM_MUL_ADD opcode. The change fuses the post-norm residual add into the RMS_NORM_MUL operation to improve performance by keeping data in HVX registers, while also simplifying the overall fusion logic and logging.
